screens.title: Browser pane with tabs, start page and load error
screens.notes: One tab = today's header plus a + button. Two or more tabs = the strip takes the title's place. Every tab of a pane shares the pane's cookie partition. A pane or tab with no address shows the start page; a failed load shows Harnu's error page instead of a blank view. The address field focus has one border (global focus ring opted out). The agent connection is one pulsing icon; hovering it shows who is connected and what it is doing (paused and disconnected keep their text pill, since they need to be seen).
